'''Michele''' is a male NPC who appears in [[Ragunna]]. He works at Trattoria Margherita.

From 6:00 PM to 8:59 PM, he can be found talking with [[Maurizio]] at Trattoria Margherita. From 9:00 PM to 10:59 PM, he is instead talking to [[Sergio]] in [[Montelli Quarter]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;<nowiki>(9:00 PM to 10:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Sergio:''' Showing up this late, the dish is nearly cold! This was saved especially for your grandmother.
:'''Michele:''' Thank you, Uncle Sergio!
:'''Sergio:''' Who's your Uncle?
:'''Michele:''' What?
:'''Sergio:''' Call me "Sir"!
:'''Michele:'''Alright... Sir... Sergio.
:'''Sergio:''' Hmph, that's more like it. Here, is a balm specially made for Septimont gladiators—it's top-notch! Take it back to Giovanni.
:'''Sergio:''' Poor young lad... thrown his back out getting headbutted by a Tumbleyak...
:'''Michele:''' I must insist on paying you!
:'''Sergio:''' Quit your babbling! As if I'd take your money!
:'''Sergio:''' Apollonia is waiting for your proposal...
:'''Michele:''' I just got a promising new job. Once I make a name for myself, I'll—
:'''Sergio:''' Hold it... Don't make my daughter wait forever, or there'll be consequences!
----
;<nowiki>(6:00 PM to 8:59 PM)</nowiki>
:'''Maurizio:''' Here are the ingredients you ordered. Do a run down and I just need you to sign here when you're ready.
:'''Michele:''' Giovanni's the one that usually handles our deliveries. How come he's not here today?
:'''Maurizio:''' Don't get me started. Giovanni got nailed in the back by a Tumbleyak at the ranch. Takes him forever to even get off the bed.
:'''Maurizio:''' Weird, the animals at Egla Ranch have gotten really frantic lately.
:'''Maurizio:''' Speaking of him, it just hit me—doesn't Rosemary's potion work really well for injuries?
:'''Michele:''' That's true.
:'''Maurizio:''' But I've heard she's a [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia]]...
:'''Michele:''' That's also true.
:'''Maurizio:''' Ha, no wonder Giovanni didn't want to go see her by himself and wanted me to tag along...
:'''Michele:''' Don't worry. You have no reason to fear her. Rosemary is really nice, and not everyone from the Fisalia family is bad.
{{Dialogue End}}
